qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for cylinder head bolts on the 7AZ engine?
What torque angles are specified for the 7AZ cylinder head bolts after the initial torque?
What engine types use M70/S70/M73 cylinder head bolts?
What is the initial torque specification for 8AZ cylinder head bolts?
How do the torque angles differ between 7AZ and 8AZ engines?
qa_pairs.answer: 7AZ uses 60° for both angles, while 8AZ uses 80° for both angles

qa_pairs.question: What engine types are associated with M60/1/M60/2/M62 cylinder head bolts?
What special instruction is given for cylinder head bolt installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Fit new cylinder head bolts and do not wash away coating on cylinder head screws

qa_pairs.question: What type of screws should be used for repair work on cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: Only use screws with Torx head

qa_pairs.question: Are the initial torque values the same for both 7AZ and 8AZ cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both require 30 Nm initial torque
